new_discoveries.title: SELF — artist talk and opening
new_discoveries.description: At Fotografiska, three emerging photographers discuss identity, self-expression and the creative process; artist talk at 19:00.

new_discoveries.description: Improvisation, play, impulse and clown technique at Teaterstudio in Bandhagen. A course rather than a one-off drop-in; confirm participation requirements.

new_discoveries.title: Chamber / Cacti — Royal Swedish Ballet
new_discoveries.dates: 4, 5, 11 & 14 Nov · listed performances; check time for each
new_discoveries.description: Two sharply contrasting modern dance works combining ritualistic movement, physical precision and playful theatricality.
new_discoveries.image_alt: Chamber production photograph: dancers moving across a blue-lit stage
new_discoveries.image_rights_status: No independent redistribution license asserted; linked official image

new_discoveries.title: Borda — Lia Rodrigues
new_discoveries.description: Brazilian contemporary dance: nine performers build a fluid landscape of fabric and recycled materials around the idea of borders.
new_discoveries.image_alt: Borda production photograph: a figure surrounded by translucent fabric and plastic on a dark stage

new_discoveries.price: From 450 SEK (third-party listing; verify at checkout)
new_discoveries.description: A single-session adult painting workshop at ABF-huset, focusing on the expressive possibilities of ink and line.

new_discoveries.title: Fight Symphony — Seungwoo Park
new_discoveries.description: A 40-minute performance turns martial-arts movement and fighting into ritual, followed by an artist conversation. Galleri Steinsland Berliner.

new_discoveries.description: An immersive blend of costume exhibition, drag performance, live singing and visual storytelling at Fotografiska. Swedish-language.

worth_reconsidering.title: Cirkus Cirkör — aerial acrobatics masterclass
worth_reconsidering.description: 1 Nov is beginner/intermediate; 8 Nov recommends prior aerial experience. Physical challenge in the circus hall at Cirkör House.

worth_reconsidering.title: The White Chapel — Johan Kärrman
worth_reconsidering.description: Experimental movement performance at Weld about the body, identity and escaping the pressure of images.

worth_reconsidering.title: Meet the Artists in Omfamnad — textile sculpture
worth_reconsidering.description: Artist talk with Sanne Lovén Rolén, then print textiles and make a soft sculpture at Kulturhuset.

worth_reconsidering.title: Movements of Resistance — Sara Soumah
worth_reconsidering.description: Solo dance at Fylkingen weaving physical movement with projection, poetry and sound.

worth_reconsidering.title: Stockholm Gallery Weekend
worth_reconsidering.description: Gallery openings, artist talks, guided tours and occasional performances. The detailed programme makes this better than a generic gallery walk.

worth_reconsidering.title: Glassfusing session — Creativity House
worth_reconsidering.description: Cut and fuse colored glass into a small object or piece of jewelry. Different technique from excluded glassblowing.

worth_reconsidering.title: Klang Systematiek — Marclay / Chiari
worth_reconsidering.description: Experimental sound and acoustic/electronic composition at Fylkingen.

worth_reconsidering.title: Stockholm International Film Festival

worth_reconsidering.price: Depends on screening; individual ticket prices unverified

worth_reconsidering.title: Music and Machine — AI in Artistic Creation
worth_reconsidering.description: Composer/AI researcher Ali Nikrang and a live demonstration of the machine-learning instrument The Spectral Parrot at Goethe-Institut.

worth_reconsidering.price: Price unverified; check Konträr subscription/booking conditions
worth_reconsidering.description: Watch a feature film made live in the room; audience members may become extras while AI transforms the filmed environments. Swedish-language.

worth_reconsidering.description: A physical, self-learning eight-string machine performs with live double bass at Fylkingen. A rare direct encounter with embodied AI.

worth_reconsidering.title: Visioner av Nuet — art & technology festival
worth_reconsidering.dates: 13 Nov at Fylkingen from 15:30; 14 Nov at Tekniska museet 13:30–20:30
worth_reconsidering.price: 13 Nov programme free per Goethe; 14 Nov daytime museum admission, evening separate ticket (amount unverified)
worth_reconsidering.description: Electronic art, historic computer films, live coding and a feedback-controlled robot; Wisdome evening sessions on 14 Nov at 18:30 and 19:45.

worth_reconsidering.title: Meet the Artists in Omfamnad — soapstone carving
worth_reconsidering.description: Meet sculptor Yasmina Karli Malmsten, then carve, file and polish a small soapstone model.

worth_reconsidering.title: Below Zero — In Praise of Shadows
worth_reconsidering.description: Seven acrobats and live folk music in a visual contemporary circus performance at Dansens Hus; family-oriented but not just for children.

worth_reconsidering.title: Uvula — Anna Nowicka
worth_reconsidering.description: Dream-themed experimental solo dance at Weld, moving between inner states, characters and imagined landscapes.

worth_reconsidering.title: Avant Joik — Moderna Museet
worth_reconsidering.description: Sámi joik meets drones, electronics, breath and visual experimentation in a live performance.

worth_reconsidering.title: Mongolian calligraphy workshop
worth_reconsidering.description: Brush-and-ink lettering and the history of Mongolian script, at Östasiatiska museet.
